title: DTRA official collecting documents on extraterrestrials

tellings.quote: person in charge of collecting all of the information from Ditra dealing with extraterrestrials and as he put it quote unquote little green men happened to sit next to me at my computer terminal and began pulling all the documents on my system and the systems in our skiff.

plain: An unnamed speaker on the show says that the official in charge of gathering everything the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, a Pentagon agency, held on extraterrestrials, or "little green men" as the official put it, once sat down at the speaker's own computer and began pulling documents off it. The speaker says this as someone who was there, and adds that the official pulled files from every system in their SCIF, a sealed room for classified work. If true, it would mean someone inside a defense agency was quietly collecting its alien-related records.
